name: Claimed
tagline: One deep pass over the refunds, settlements and compensation programs you may be owed
description: It runs one thorough pass over the official refund programs, class-action settlements and government compensation schemes in your country, then matches what it finds against your situation. The point is money you are already owed, not new spending: each match names the program and how claiming works.
author: Liam
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
